reports.title: MATTEL REPORTS THIRD QUARTER 2026 FINANCIAL RESULTS

guidance.heading: 2026 Guidance
section: For the full year 2026, the Company now expects:
•Net Sales growth in the range of 1% to 4% in constant currency,
•Adjusted Operating Income in the range of $500 million to $570 million, and
•Foreign Exchange is expected to have a roughly 1% benefit on full year Net Sales based on current spot rates, and the Adjusted Effective Tax Rate is expected to be roughly 23% for the full year.
Mattel’s revised full year 2026 guidance excludes the benefits of tariff refunds recognized year-to-date, as well as any additional tariff refunds that may be recognized during the remainder of 2026.
